description: Base contract read-only call (eth_call) with ERC-20 sugar: balanceOf / allowance / decimals / symbol / name / totalSupply. For any other function pass an explicit 4-byte selector and ABI-encoded parameter. Data source: external Base JSON-RPC. No state change.

parameter.description: ABI-encoded parameter when selector is given

selector.description: Optional 4-byte selector (8 hex) for non-ERC20 calls

name: base_read_contract
